# hls.js

Pinned upstream version: 1.7.3, full build, Apache-2.0 license (see LICENSE).

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hls.js@1.7.3/dist/hls.min.js
Upstream: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/releases/tag/v1.7.3

Served locally. The full build is required because MediaMTX advertises separate video and audio renditions. Update deliberately and rerun media playback tests including audio; no runtime CDN dependency is used.
